name: zsnd_sample_set_init
description: zSndSampleSet::Init initializes an unloaded sample set, optionally uses archive banks, falls back to loose-file resolution for still-unloaded samples, and marks resourcesLoaded.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound sample-set source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja has accepted rendering limitations for this function: the impossible archive-bank default path appears as archiveBankIndex=self, and the loose-file loop is rendered from an interior cursor at zSndSample::replayFields.flags.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a0c40 validates zIndexArchive scratch setup, null/already-loaded return 0, archive-bank attempt order, LoadSamplesFromIndexArchive on archive open, loose-file fallback for samples lacking flag bit 0x08, loaded-bit update/clear from InitFromWaveData, resourcesLoaded assignment, archive cleanup, and return value 1.

The loose-file smoke reaches Init through zSndSampleSet_InitByName, resolves a WAV via g_zSnd_SearchPathList, verifies DirectSound initialization and PCM copy, verifies an already-loaded sample is skipped, and verifies repeat initialization returns 0.
The archive-loader smoke covers the accepted LoadSamplesFromIndexArchive dependency used by Init when an archive bank opens.

A prior source-shape pass hoisted archive-bank local setup before archive.Reset(), improving from 363 to 344 mismatches; this pass improves it further to 333. The retained source shape removes a non-retail out-of-line LoadSampleFromWavePath helper, matches retail local setup order, directly dereferences g_zSnd_SoundLodValuePtr like BN, and keeps the loose-file loop as a sample cursor, but tier S remains blocked by post-Reset EH-state/guard scheduling, archive-bank control-flow/register scheduling, loose-file loop/EH ordering drift, and the tier-B 0x4a0fb0 dependency.
